name: AAVAA
evidence: Company press release boilerplate: AAVAA was formed in 2019 to pursue attention-detection; incubated at TandemLaunch by founder Naeem Komeilipoor.
conflict: BetaKit says launched 2021, which reads as commercial launch and CEO arrival rather than formation.

name: Cortivision
evidence: Founder interview via Lublin municipal investment agency: officially operating as a company since March 2019, concept formed in a Warsaw accelerator late 2018. Verifier corrected my 2020.
conflict: Tracxn gives 2020. The 2019 statement describes formal registration, so it is closer to incorporation than to a distinct founding moment.

name: Neuright Labs
evidence: Company-authored text says founded in Maine in 2018 as a C-corp, which is an incorporation statement. UMaine coverage confirms Blaszkiewicz and Townsend formed Neuright out of MIRTA but states no year.

name: Onward Medical
evidence: Founded 2014 in Eindhoven by the EPFL team behind the 2012 spinal-stimulation results (Bloch, Deckers, Courtine). Founded AS G-Therapeutics / GTX Medical; ONWARD is a 2020 rebrand.
conflict: The 2015 figure elsewhere appears to track the rebrand rather than the founding. Verifier found no credible source against 2014.

name: Axonics Modulation Technologies
evidence: SEC Form 424B5: incorporated in Delaware March 2012 as American Restorative Medicine Inc, renamed Axonics Modulation Technologies August 2013, commenced operations late 2013

name: Kernel
evidence: Founded 2016 by Bryan Johnson with a $54M investment; corroborated by kernel.com/about

name: INBRAIN Neuroelectronics
evidence: ICREA official spin-off registry: InBrain Neuroelectronics SL born December 2019. Corroborated by ICN2 spin-off page.

name: Forest Neurotech
evidence: Convergent Research lists Forest Neurotech as a Focused Research Organization it incubated, established 2023 and launched October 2023

name: Braingaze
evidence: ICREA official spin-off registry: Braingaze SL born September 2013; ICREA/University of Barcelona spin-off co-founded by Hans Super and Laszlo Bax.

name: Chronolife
evidence: Company press boilerplate: co-founded in November 2015, iBionext majority shareholder since creation.
conflict: One aggregator floats 2014; no primary source supports it.

name: BrainSigns
evidence: Company About page: born as a spin-off of the University of Rome Sapienza in 2010

name: Synergia Medical
evidence: Company About page: backed by investors since its founding in 2015. I had written 2014 from CB Insights.
conflict: Genuinely unresolved. MecaTech, the Walloon competitiveness cluster, says founded 2014 by Pascal Doguet and Attila Borbath; the company own site says 2015.

name: BRAINCONTROL
evidence: BrainControl is a brand of LiquidWeb Srl, founded in Siena in 2010 by Pasquale Fedele; first prototype shown Oct 2010. 2010 is the PARENT company founding, not a separate entity.
conflict: Product versus parent: BrainControl is a brand, not a separately founded company. Both resolve to 2010.

name: Salvia BioElectronics
evidence: Company About page boilerplate: Founded in 2017 and headquartered in Eindhoven. Secondary reporting adds incorporation 3 Mar 2017 by Hubert Martens, Daniel Schobben and Wim Pollet.

name: BrainCapture
evidence: DTU institutional news, verbatim: once the concept was shaped, the company, BrainCapture, was established in 2019. The underlying research idea dates to 2011 at DTU Compute; the company was spun out in 2019.

name: BrainCo
evidence: Company-issued release boilerplate: BrainCo was founded in February of 2015 and incubated from the Harvard Innovation Lab. Wikipedia agrees independently.

name: Actipulse Neuroscience
evidence: SEC Form C-AR: operating entity Actipulse International SA de CV incorporated 17 Apr 2017; Adrien Chatillon listed as CEO and Founder from January 2017. Y Combinator also lists 2017.
conflict: The same filing shows a Delaware holding entity organised 27 Jun 2019 which acquired the Mexican company in a 2021 share swap. That 2019 is restructuring, not founding.

name: Accure Therapeutics
evidence: Barcelona Science Park: Accure started up in 2020 after a EUR 7.6M Series A, formed by the merger of Iproteos and Bionure
conflict: 2020 is a newly created merger vehicle over Iproteos (founded 2011) and Bionure. If the index counts predecessor lineage, 2011 applies.

name: ADMdx
evidence: Federal contractor record: ADM Diagnostics Inc of Northbrook IL, in business since 2010, registered 23 Mar 2010. Every aggregator agrees on 2010; the company own site states no founding year anywhere.
conflict: An Alzheimer Drug Discovery Foundation grant to ADM Diagnostics LLC covers 8/1/09-7/31/10, so the company was active before the claimed 2010 start. A separate account describes a Chicago predecessor from 2001. Neither is resolved.

name: Activas Diagnostics
evidence: Portland Press Herald, verbatim: Activas Diagnostics, established in 2009 and based in the UpStart Center for Entrepreneurship in Orono. UMaine ECE confirms the spin-off and founders but states no year.

name: Cortexplore
evidence: tech2b, the Upper Austrian public startup incubator, lists project start 2018; Austrian commercial register shows registration 03.12.2018. The company own About page states no year.
conflict: All sources converge on 2018 but none is a primary founding statement; the register date is incorporation.

name: Aspen Neuroscience
evidence: Company boilerplate, verbatim: the Loring lab team formed Aspen Neuroscience in 2018. The widely cited Dec 2019 event was the public launch with a $6.5M seed, not the founding.

name: Sunrise
evidence: Company-issued release boilerplate: Founded in 2015 by Laurent and Pierre Martinot. Independently verified.

name: ModiusHealth
evidence: Founded by Dr Paul McGeoch and Dr Jason McKeown in 2015; now operates as Neurovalens from Belfast and San Diego
conflict: Verifier found NEUROVALENS LIMITED (NI617853) incorporated 12 Apr 2013 at UK Companies House, and coverage giving 2015. 2013 is incorporation, not founding. Unresolved between 2013 and 2015.

name: Emotion ID
evidence: Crunchbase gives 2014; Bratislava; founders Milan Martinkovic and Filip Stano; camera-based emotion detection

name: MicroVention Terumo
evidence: Company press release marking 25 years in neuroendovascular technologies; founded 1997 in Southern California, acquired by Terumo 2006, rebranded Terumo Neuro Sept 2024

name: Avalon AI
evidence: Gust startup profile gives 2015; London; ML on brain MRI to predict MCI-to-dementia progression, trained on 70,000 scans via Cambridge, Donders and Imperial partnerships

name: ATENTIVmynd
evidence: Tracxn gives 2012, founded by Eric Gordon; EEG headband and game that trains attention in children with ADHD; covered by Crains New York (2013), Boston Magazine (2016) and MassDevelopment

name: Cerebian
evidence: Tracxn gives 2008, founders Kareem Ayyad and Sima Hoseingholizade; BrainOS neural interface; named a 2018 Ontario Brain Institute ONtrepreneur
conflict: A 2008 founding sits oddly with the company first appearing in Ontario Brain Institute programmes in 2018. Aggregator-only.
